text:
Dear Larkspur team,

I'm writing to book The Fenwick for my daughter's wedding - I'm still on cloud nine thinking about it, to be honest. We're planning for April 18, 2027, and I was wondering if it's available to be picked up from your garage at 11:00 and returned to the same spot at 18:30. 

I'd love to arrange it so that one of your chauffeurs is driving it with wedding ribbons attached - I think that would be the perfect touch. I've attached my driving licence, by the way, as I'm not sure if you need it for the booking.

Cheers,
Una Dunsmere 
+70 591 796 9057
